correctness.rationale: Geometric strict tangent cone at -e1 is u1>sum_{j>1}|uj|, so 2d cones disjoint modulo boundaries. Gaussian radial invariance, half-normal simplex substitution, radial Gamma integral yield exact Dirichlet prefactor. Dirichlet factorial moments give EY=(d-1)/(d+1), Var Y=1/d+O(1/d²), and E S²=4/d²+O(d^-3), hence EW=e^-1[1+7/(2d)+O(d^-3/2)] with fourth-moment control. Under W-tilted Dirichlet, W->e^-1 and boundedness imply total-variation closeness; independent Exp representation proves fixed-k signed Laplace limits and d(1-U1)->1. Independent sampling and symbolic spot checks support but do not replace the analytic proof.
